segments.an10.149:1.1: “Uppādetabbañca vo, bhikkhave, dhammaṃ desessāmi na uppādetabbañca.
segments.an10.149:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha … pe … katamo ca, bhikkhave, na uppādetabbo dhammo?
segments.an10.149:1.4: Micchādiṭṭhi … pe … micchāvimutti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, na uppādetabbo dhammo.
segments.an10.149:1.7: Sammādiṭṭhi … pe … sammāvimutti – ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, uppādetabbo dhammo”ti.
